meta.note: price_at_test_usd is the US retail price at the time of VT testing, not a current market price.
meta.market_price_note: Each country only takes prices from its own shops: Geizhals and Idealo (DE, AT), toppreise.ch (CH); Amazon when comparison sites have none. Median daily price over 14 days (30 when there are too few); implausible offers are dropped (market_prices_outliers).

protection_groups.label: Spherical
protection_groups.hint: Ball-and-socket liners rotate as a unit (MIPS Spherical, Bell/Giro Spherical)

protection_groups.label: Slip-plane
protection_groups.hint: Low-friction layer lets the helmet slide on your head to reduce twist forces (MIPS, SPIN, 2Vi)

protection_groups.label: Crumple
protection_groups.hint: Honeycomb or tube structures collapse to absorb impact energy (WaveCel, Koroyd) — not a sliding layer

protection_groups.label: None
protection_groups.hint: No detected rotational or crumple technology

protection_technologies.label: Koroyd
protection_technologies.hint: Welded tube cores that crumple on impact
